title: The Venox Menace
description: Jorn Kess, a farmer in the Caldon settlement, is desperate for help. The venox creatures have been getting bolder, coming closer to the settlement and attacking farms. Last week, they attacked one of the farms, and the settlers are afraid. They're not fighters, but they can't just abandon their homes. Can you help clear out the venox nest?
shortDescription: Clear out the venox nest threatening the settlement

objectives.description: Speak with farmer Jorn Kess about the venox problem
Locate the venox nest near the settlement
Defeat the venox creatures in the nest
Clear out the venox nest completely
Return to Jorn Kess to report success
